description: This file contains SwiftUI and AppKit code for custom text views used in a macOS Voice Wake overlay interface. It implements a representable view with text editing, display, and interaction handling, including a transcript text view and a vibrant label with tap recognition.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: A coordinator class for handling NSTextView delegate callbacks within the TranscriptTextView.

classes.name: ClickCatcher
classes.description: An NSView subclass that detects mouse clicks to trigger a tap callback.

classes.name: TranscriptNSTextView
classes.description: A custom NSTextView subclass with additional callbacks for sending input, editing state changes, and escape key handling.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Coordinator instance for managing delegate callbacks.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Constructs and configures an NSScrollView containing a TranscriptNSTextView, setting properties and callbacks.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSScrollView's document view with new attributed text if changed.

methods.name: textDidBeginEditing
methods.description: Notification callback triggered when text editing begins.

methods.name: textDidEndEditing
methods.description: Notification callback triggered when text editing ends.

methods.name: textDidChange
methods.description: Notification callback triggered when the text content changes.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSView containing an attributed label, with tap handling.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the label's attributed string and appearance.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse click to trigger a tap callback.

methods.name: becomeFirstResponder
methods.description: Handles focus gain, triggering editing begin callback.

methods.name: resignFirstResponder
methods.description: Handles focus loss, triggering editing end callback.

methods.name: keyDown
methods.description: Handles key events for return, shift+return, command+return, and escape, triggering respective callbacks.
